name: ClearThink 1 Acquisition Corp.
summary: ClearThink 1 Acquisition Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), an organization established with the explicit goal of completing a business combination. Its primary aim is to engage in a merger, acquisition, share exchange, asset purchase, share acquisition, reorganization, or other similar corporate transaction with one or more target businesses or entities. This firm was officially formed on September 11, 2025, and has its principal headquarters located in Boca Raton, Florida.
